title: 10DLC Registration Best Practices: Making Compliance Easy

facts.fact: The page defines 10DLC as a 10-digit phone number approved by TCR (The Campaign Registry) on behalf of mobile network operators (MNOs) for A2P messaging.
facts.quote: 10DLC stands for the 10-digit phone number that is approved by TCR – The Campaign Registry on behalf of the mobile network operators (MNOs) for A2P messaging.

facts.fact: The page states that 10DLC registration involves three steps: brand registration, campaign registration, and number assignment.
Brand registration with TCR requires business information including legal entity name, contact details, and tax identification number.
facts.quote: you need to provide accurate business information, which includes your legal entity name, contact details, tax identification number, etc.

facts.fact: Campaign registration requires the business to define each campaign's purpose, target audience, and message type.
facts.quote: You need to clearly define each campagin’s purpose, target audience, message type to be sent, etc.

facts.fact: The page advises that an eCommerce business sending order updates should select the "Customer Care" use case rather than "Promotional."
facts.quote: you need to select the “Customer Care” use case instead of “Promotional.”
